Join us, we're hiring.


## What is Cypress?

## Installing Install Cypress for Mac, Linux, or Windows, then [get started](https://on.cypress.io/install). ```bash npm install cypress --save-dev ``` or ```bash yarn add cypress --dev ``` or ```bash pnpm add cypress --save-dev ``` ## Contributing - `develop` branch Please see our [Contributing Guideline](./CONTRIBUTING.md) which explains repo organization, linting, testing, and other steps. ## License This project is licensed under the terms of the [MIT license](/LICENSE). ## Badges Configure a badge for your project's README to show your test status or test count in the [Cypress Cloud](https://www.cypress.io/cloud). Or let the world know your project is using Cypress with the badge below. ``` ```
readmeHtml:
Documentation | Changelog | Roadmap

The web has evolved. Finally, testing has too.

Fast, easy and reliable testing for anything that runs in a browser.

Join us, we're hiring.


What is Cypress?

Installing

Install Cypress for Mac, Linux, or Windows, then get started.

npm install cypress --save-dev

or

yarn add cypress --dev

or

pnpm add cypress --save-dev

Contributing

- develop branch

Please see our Contributing Guideline which explains repo organization, linting, testing, and other steps.

License

This project is licensed under the terms of the MIT license.

Badges

Configure a badge for your project's README to show your test status or test count in the Cypress Cloud.

Or let the world know your project is using Cypress with the badge below.

[![Cypress.io](https://img.shields.io/badge/tested%20with-Cypress-04C38E.svg)](https://www.cypress.io/)

aiSummary.oneLiner: A reliable, fast end-to-end testing framework built for the modern web.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: Cypress provides a comprehensive testing environment that executes directly within the browser alongside the application. It eliminates flaky tests by automatically waiting for DOM elements to appear and network requests to complete before asserting conditions. The framework includes a visual interface for time-traveling through test execution, allowing developers to inspect application state at any step. It bypasses the limitations of Selenium by hooking directly into the browser's execution loop. Cypress supports end-to-end testing, component testing, and API testing natively.
keyFeatures: In-browser execution: Runs in the same run-loop as the application for direct access to DOM and application variables.
Automatic waiting: Pauses test execution until elements are visible and animations finish, eliminating manual sleep commands.
Time travel debugging: Captures snapshots at every test step, enabling developers to inspect the DOM visually after a failure.
Network traffic control: Stubs and intercepts network requests to test edge cases without a backend server.
Real-time reloads: Automatically reruns tests the moment developers save a file.
Cross-browser support: Executes identical test suites across Chrome, Firefox, and Edge browsers natively.
Dashboard integration: Syncs test results to a central cloud service to track historical flakiness and performance.

useCases.title: End-to-End Testing
useCases.description: QA engineers use Cypress to simulate real user journeys, ensuring critical paths like checkout flows function correctly.

useCases.title: Component Testing
useCases.description: Frontend developers mount React or Vue components in isolation to verify their behavior without spinning up the full app.

useCases.title: API Verification
useCases.description: Backend developers utilize Cypress to run assertions against API endpoints during the CI pipeline.

useCases.title: Flakiness Reduction
useCases.description: Teams migrate from legacy testing frameworks to Cypress to stabilize their CI/CD pipelines and reduce false negatives.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: Cypress is for QA engineers and frontend developers who want a reliable, easy-to-configure testing environment. It is aimed at teams looking to integrate robust UI testing tightly into their daily development workflow.
